newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan June first 20 days trade surplus 453 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan June first 20 days trade surplus 453 bln yen.

text.p: Japan posted a customs-cleared trade surplus of 453.20 billion yen in the first 20 days of June, compared with a surplus of 197.65 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
The figure represented a year-on-year rise of 129.3 percent.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 19.1 percent from a year earlier to 2.69 trillion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 8.5 percent to 2.24 trillion yen.
